title: Kitten dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='28' ry='4' fill='#2a1a4a' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72 62 Q88 55 84 38 Q82 30 76 32 Q80 42 74 50 Q70 55 66 58' fill='#f7a63b' stroke='#e08a20' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- back leg (left) -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='82' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#e8912d' transform='rotate(-15 38 82)'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='89' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#f9d29b'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='17' ry='18' fill='#f7a63b'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#fbd9a0'/>

  <!-- front leg (right, raised in dance) -->
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='76' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#e8912d' transform='rotate(25 60 76)'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='82' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f9d29b' transform='rotate(25 64 82)'/>

  <!-- left arm up -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='56' rx='5' ry='9' fill='#e8912d' transform='rotate(-40 36 56)'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='48' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#f9d29b' transform='rotate(-40 30 48)'/>

  <!-- right arm raised -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='54' rx='5' ry='9' fill='#e8912d' transform='rotate(40 64 54)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='46' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#f9d29b' transform='rotate(40 70 46)'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#f7a63b'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#fbd9a0'/>

  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M35 30 L33 16 L45 27 Z' fill='#f7a63b' stroke='#e08a20' stroke-width='1' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M37 27 L35.5 20 L42 26 Z' fill='#ffc8d8'/>
  <path d='M65 30 L67 16 L55 27 Z' fill='#f7a63b' stroke='#e08a20' stroke-width='1' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M63 27 L64.5 20 L58 26 Z' fill='#ffc8d8'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='40' rx='3.5' ry='4.5' fill='#2ec4b6'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='38.5' r='1.4' fill='#e8fffb'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='40' rx='3.5' ry='4.5' fill='#2ec4b6'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='38.5' r='1.4' fill='#e8fffb'/>

  <!-- nose and mouth -->
  <path d='M48 47 L52 47 L50 49 Z' fill='#ff7aa2'/>
  <path d='M50 49 Q47 53 44 51' fill='none' stroke='#c46a1e' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 49 Q53 53 56 51' fill='none' stroke='#c46a1e' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M42 46 L28 44' stroke='#c46a1e' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M42 49 L28 50' stroke='#c46a1e' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 46 L72 44' stroke='#c46a1e' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 49 L72 50' stroke='#c46a1e' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- stripes on head -->
  <path d='M44 30 Q50 27 56 30' stroke='#e08a20' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- musical notes for dancing -->
  <g fill='#ff7aa2'>
    <path d='M24 22 L24 14 L30 12 L30 20 Z'/>
    <circle cx='22' cy='22' r='3'/>
    <circle cx='28' cy='20' r='3'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#2ec4b6'>
    <path d='M76 18 L76 10 L82 8 L82 16 Z'/>
    <circle cx='74' cy='18' r='2.5'/>
    <circle cx='80' cy='16' r='2.5'/>
  </g>
</svg>
